from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class FinancialPeriod(BaseModel):
    """One quarterly financial data point from a Gree Electric report."""
    year: str | None = Field(description="The calendar year of the report period")
    quarter: Literal['第一季度', '第三季度'] = Field(description="The quarter in the year: 第一季度 or 第三季度")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The comprehensive income attributable to parent company shareholders amount, as written (in yuan)")
    unit: Literal['元'] = Field(description="Currency unit, always yuan for Chinese financial reports")
    period_type: Literal['quarterly', 'cumulative_ytd'] | None = Field(description="Whether this is a quarterly or year-to-date cumulative amount")
    quote: str = Field(description="A brief excerpt from the document containing this data point")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_periods: list[FinancialPeriod]
